me:2017:q10.title: GATE ME 2017 | Set 1 | Question: 10
me:2017:q10.question: Saturated steam at $100^{\circ}$C condenses  on the outside of a tube.cold fluid enters the tube at  $20^{\circ}$C and exits at $50^{\circ}$C the value of the log mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) is _________$^{\circ}$C.

me:2017:q11.title: GATE ME 2017 | Set 1 | Question: 11
me:2017:q11.question: The molar Specific heat at constant volume of an ideal gas in equal to 2.5 times the universal gas constant(8.314 J/mol K). When the temperature increases by 100 K, the change in molar specific enthalpy is__________ J/mol.

primary.subtopicLabel: First Law, Heat, Work and Energy

detailed_solution.concept: Thermodynamics - First Law, Heat, Work and Energy
detailed_solution.markdown:
Given that:$\bar{C}_{v}=2.5 \bar{R}$

$\bar{C}_{v} \rightarrow$ Molar specific heat at constant volume

$$\begin{aligned} \bar{C}_{p}-\bar{C}_{v}&=\bar{R}\\ \Rightarrow \quad \bar{C}_{p}&=\bar{R}+\bar{C}_{v}=\bar{R}+2.5 \bar{R} \\ \bar{C}_{p}&=3.5 \bar{R} \end{aligned}$$

Molar specific enthalpy change of ideal gas (A H)

$$\begin{aligned} \Delta H &=n \bar{C}_{p} \Delta T \\ \overline{\Delta H} &=\frac{\Delta H}{n}=\overline{\Delta H}=\bar{C}_{p} \Delta T \\ &=3.5 \times 8.314 \times 100 \\ \overline{\Delta H} &=2909.9 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{mole} \end{aligned}$$

Therefore, the correct answer is **2909.5** (acceptable range: [2908, 2911]).

detailed_solution.markdown: $m=1 \mathrm{kg} ; \quad R=400 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{kg}-\mathrm{k}$ $$\begin{aligned} c_{v}&=1000 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{kg}-\mathrm{K} \\ T_{i}&=300 \mathrm{K} ; P_{i}=100 \mathrm{kPa} \\ W&=100 \mathrm{kJ} \end{aligned}$$ Applying first law: $$\begin{aligned} Q&=\Delta U+W\\ \Rightarrow \quad 0&=m c_{v}\left(T_{f}-T_{i}\right)+(-100) \times 10^{3} J \\ \Rightarrow \quad 0&=1 \times 1000 \times\left(T_{f}-300\right)-100 \times 10^{3} \\ \Rightarrow \quad T_{f}&=400 \mathrm{K} \end{aligned}$$ Entropy change for ideal gas $$\begin{aligned} \Delta S &=m\left[C_{v} \ln \frac{T_{f}}{T_{i}}+R \ln \frac{V_{f}}{V_{i}}\right] \quad \because V_{i}=V_{f} \\ &=1 \times\left[1000 \ln \frac{400}{300}+0\right] \\ &=287.682 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{K} \end{aligned}$$ Therefore, the correct answer is **287** (acceptable range: [285, 289]).

me:2017:q36.question: Air contains 79% N2 and 21%  $O_{2}$ on a molar basis. Methane ($CH_{4}$) is burned with 50% excess air than required stoichiometrically. Assuming complete combustion of methane, the molar percentage of $N_{2}$  in the products is _______________

Stoichiometrically balanced equation for combustion of ${\mathrm{CH}}_4$
